How Dave works

A few things you’ll
always be able to count on.

Not policies. Just how Dave is.

Straight, honest communication

Dave walks you through exactly what he sees, what the project needs, and what to expect — clearly and completely, at every stage.

“I want you to feel completely informed. A well-informed homeowner makes the whole project go better.”

Deep respect for your home

Dave treats every home with the same care he’d give his own — clean, careful, and considerate from the first day to the last.

“When I’m in your home, I’m a guest. I take that seriously.”

Work that stands behind itself

Every project is finished to the standard Dave would be proud to put his name on. If something isn’t right, he makes it right.

“My reputation is built one job at a time. I’m not about to stop caring now.”

Who Dave is

A craftsman.
A father.
A good person.

Dave Pequite has spent over 20 years building and finishing homes across Northern Colorado. He works alone — because doing the work himself is the only way to deliver the quality he genuinely cares about.

He’s a single dad and a rock climber. Both have shaped how he operates. Climbing teaches you that preparation matters, honesty keeps everyone safe, and you are fully accountable for every move.

“The mountain has a way of showing you who you really are. I try to bring that same honesty and care into every home I work in.”
Genuine
Straightforward person who loves his craft.
Skilled
20 years of precision. Results speak for themselves.
Reliable
Shows up when he says. Finishes what he starts.
Caring
Genuinely wants your home to be better.

“I’m raising my kid on this work.
There’s no better reason to do it right.”

— Dave on why every project is personal
